ruleDefinitions.name: Meterpreter or Cobalt Strike Getsystem Service Installation - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of getsystem Meterpreter/Cobalt Strike command by detecting a specific service installation Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: event_id = 4697 AND (((ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\/c.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*echo.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\\\pipe\\\\.*")) AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*cmd.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\%COMSPEC\\%.*"))) OR (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*rundll32.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\,a.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\/p\\:.*")) OR ServiceFileName = RGX("^\\\\\\\\127\\\.0\\\.0\\\.1\\\\ADMIN\\$\\\\"))
